action: I would edit two architecture sections and save the first, or follow a References link while still editing.
observed: Implementation review only; no interactions performed. Each section has its own ordinary POST form, and References and Document status are normal links. Section forms lack data-busy; the supplied forms.ts adds no dirty-state tracking or navigation guard.
problem: Only one section is submitted at a time, leaving my other unsaved correction vulnerable to being lost when the page navigates, with no visible indication of which edits remain unsaved.
suggestion: Track dirty sections and offer Save all or a navigation warning that identifies the unsaved sections.

action: I would correct architecture prose while keeping the generated tables.

problem: The only Save edit action destroys the tables I need to keep, so I cannot achieve my editing goal through the provided control even though the warning explains the loss.
suggestion: Preserve generated tables when saving prose and provide a separate explicit action to remove them.

action: I would use Regenerate to try a better architecture section and compare it with my current draft.
observed: Implementation review only; no interactions performed. Regenerate sits beside Save edit without data-confirm. Its storage branch deletes the current section record and queues regeneration; the provided UI exposes no previous-version or undo control.
problem: A single click removes my saved draft before replacement text is available, with no visible way to recover it if regeneration is worse or fails.
suggestion: Keep the current section as a recoverable version until I accept the regenerated replacement.
